column3: drink water, about six to eight cups a day, more when hot or active
column4: your body needs water to work well

column2: a small cut or scraped knee
column3: wash it with clean water, press with a clean cloth to stop bleeding, and cover with a plaster or bandage
column4: cleaning stops infection and covering keeps dirt out

column2: a bruise after bumping into something
column3: put a cold pack wrapped in a cloth on it for a few minutes

column2: hitting your head hard in the playground
column3: tell an adult even if you feel fine

column2: touching something hot like an oven or iron
column3: cool the burn under cool running water for 20 minutes and tell an adult
column4: cooling stops the burn going deeper

column2: worrying that you are shorter or taller than friends
column3: everyone grows at their own pace
column4: growth spurts come at different ages

column2: not being able to see the board at school
column3: tell a teacher and a parent
column4: you may need an eye test
